Reading your bill

Your bill has three parts: the monthly plan charge, one-off charges, and any credit applied.

One-off charges include engineer call-out fees and late payment fees. Each one is listed with the date it was added.

If a charge looks wrong, raise a request under "A bill or payment" and quote the invoice number from the top right of the bill.
